items.summary: A bench of Acting CJ Nitin Wasudeo Sambre and Justice Sanjay Sharma adjourned to Friday Oct 16 the PIL (law student Anshika Tripathi + an advocate) challenging closure of 57 metro stations, railway disruptions, preventive detentions and interception of travellers ahead of the Oct 10 protest, plus house arrests of protesters including politicians. The court asked the petitioner to place on record copies of the similar petitions pending before the Supreme Court, saying it did not want to pass contradictory orders. ASG Chetan Sharma said the SC metro-stations PIL is listed Thursday (Oct 15).
items.title: Delhi HC adjourns metro-stations PIL to Friday Oct 16, seeks SC plea copies

items.summary: The Delhi High Court adjourned to November the PIL by NSUI national president Vinod Jakhar seeking a fair, independent, time-bound probe into the Oct-10 daylight assaults on ordinary protesters by alleged anti-social elements in civil dress at Connaught Place and adjoining roads. ASG objected to the PIL's maintainability (filed in violation of PIL rules); the court gave the Centre three weeks to file preliminary objections. Jakhar's counsel asked the court to direct preservation of CCTV footage (Oct 10, 12 noon-6 PM) from CP Inner/Outer Circle, Indira Chowk, Sansad Marg, Janpath, Jantar Mantar Road and four metro stations.
items.title: Delhi HC adjourns NSUI outsiders-assault PIL to November; Centre gets 3 weeks

items.summary: Justice Amit Mahajan issued notice on the Indian Youth Congress plea (filed by president Uday Bhanu Chib) seeking a fresh, reasoned assessment of its rejected request to protest against CEC Gyanesh Kumar, and listed the matter in November. Sr Adv Siddharth Luthra dropped the Jantar Mantar-specific prayer and said he will amend the prayers after Delhi Police's Oct-11 de-notification circular; ASG Sharma opposed notice, arguing the petition cannot sustain unless the de-notification order itself is challenged. No interim relief.
items.title: Delhi HC issues notice on IYC protest-permission plea; matter listed in November
